name: Ground Turkey Taco Bowl
summary: Taco-spiced turkey with black beans and corn over rice. Naturally gluten-free.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until softened.
Add the ground turkey and cook 7–8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the black beans and corn with 3 tbsp water. Simmer 5 minutes until heated through. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the rice among four bowls and spoon the turkey mixture over top.
Scatter the green onions over each bowl and serve.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check any pre-mixed taco seasoning for wheat-based fillers if you use it instead of individual spices.

budgetNotes: Ground turkey is the main cost. Medium ground beef is a similar price if turkey is not on sale.
The beans and corn stretch a single small package of turkey across four full bowls.
Top with hot sauce, salsa, or a squeeze of lime — all cheap ways to finish it.
